name: @openobserve/experiment-action
description: GitHub Action: run an OpenObserve LLM experiment, compare it with the baseline, comment on the PR, and gate on regressions

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
